responsibility: This file implements cached allocation, recycling, and basic manipulation of RTL EXPR_LIST and INSN_LIST nodes. It maintains free lists for reusable list nodes, provides alloc/free helpers that avoid repeated rtx allocation, supports removing or copying list elements, and offers list-wide release routines used by RTL passes and note-handling code. Its responsibility is low-level list-node memory management for RTL list structures, separate from the semantic use of those lists by particular passes.
